entry.question: How do I schedule a page?
entry.answer: Set the go-live date and click Publish. Developers must configure the scheduling command. Source: /scheduling/.

retrieval.returned_excerpt: Set the go-live date and click Publish. Saving a draft alone will not schedule it.
